chunks: And in another report, the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله said:
"Delay the loading, for the two forelegs are suspended and the two hind legs are bound."

key_terms.الْأَحْمَالَ: the loads or burdens being placed on animals
key_terms.الْيَدَيْنِ: the two forelegs or front limbs
key_terms.اَلنَّبِيُّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم teach about treating animals during loading?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs people to show care and restraint when loading animals, emphasizing their physical vulnerability during the process. It reflects an Islamic ethic of mercy and justice toward animals and a prohibition against harshness and oppression.
